name: Sandspiel
tagline: Pour sand, water, fire and plants. Watch them react.
description:
Close it, keep the GIF, and the dunes go with it.

Pick an element and paint with a finger or a mouse. Sand piles. Water finds a way down. Lava turns water to stone. Fire eats wood. Plants drink. Pause, undo, reset. Five brush sizes, from a dot to a splash.

Name a board to keep an extra copy on this device. Playing with friends is a wall of worlds: press Play together, then Invite in the bar above the app, and send the link. Friends land on the wall, pin a board as a card, tap a card to open it.

An unofficial port of Sandspiel by Max Bittker. This copy swaps the public gallery for a meeting wall.
